tool_list.name: getNetworks
tool_list.description: REQUIRED FIRST STEP: Get all supported blockchain networks. Always call this first to see available networks before using any network-specific functions. Returns network IDs like "ethereum", "solana", etc.

tool_list.name: getNetworkDexes
tool_list.description: Get available DEXes on a specific network. First call getNetworks to see valid network IDs.

tool_list.name: getNetworkPools
tool_list.description: PRIMARY POOL FUNCTION: Get top liquidity pools on a specific network. This is the MAIN way to get pool data - there is NO global pools function. Use this instead of any "getTopPools" or "getAllPools" concepts.

tool_list.name: getDexPools
tool_list.description: Get pools from a specific DEX on a network. First use getNetworks, then getNetworkDexes to find valid DEX IDs.

tool_list.name: getPoolDetails
tool_list.description: Get detailed information about a specific pool. Requires network ID from getNetworks and a pool address.

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio

tool_list.name: getTokenDetails
tool_list.description: Get detailed information about a specific token on a network. First use getNetworks to get valid network IDs.

tool_list.name: getTokenPools
tool_list.description: Get liquidity pools containing a specific token on a network. Great for finding where a token is traded.

reorder.description: If true, reorders the pool so that the specified token becomes the primary token for all metrics

address.description: Filter pools that contain this additional token address

tool_list.name: getPoolOHLCV
tool_list.description: Get historical price data (OHLCV) for a pool - essential for price analysis, backtesting, and visualization. Requires network and pool address.

start.description: Start time for historical data (Unix timestamp, RFC3339 timestamp, or yyyy-mm-dd format)

end.description: End time for historical data (max 1 year from start)

limit.description: Number of data points to retrieve (max 366) - adjust for different analysis needs

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio for alternative pair perspective (e.g., ETH/USDC vs USDC/ETH)

tool_list.name: getPoolTransactions
tool_list.description: Get recent transactions for a specific pool. Shows swaps, adds, removes. Requires network and pool address.

page.description: Page number for pagination (up to 100 pages)

cursor.description: Transaction ID used for cursor-based pagination

tool_list.name: search
tool_list.description: Search across ALL networks for tokens, pools, and DEXes by name, symbol, or address. Good starting point when you don't know the specific network.

query.description: Search term (e.g., "uniswap", "bitcoin", or a token address)

tool_list.name: getStats
tool_list.description: Get high-level statistics about the DexPaprika ecosystem: total networks, DEXes, pools, and tokens available.

tool_list.name: getNetworks

tool_list.name: getNetworkDexes
tool_list.description: Get available DEXes on a specific network. First call getNetworks to see valid network IDs.

tool_list.name: getNetworkPools
tool_list.description: PRIMARY POOL FUNCTION: Get top liquidity pools on a specific network. This is the MAIN way to get pool data - there is NO global pools function. Use this instead of any "getTopPools" or "getAllPools" concepts.

tool_list.name: getDexPools
tool_list.description: Get pools from a specific DEX on a network. First use getNetworks, then getNetworkDexes to find valid DEX IDs.

tool_list.name: getPoolDetails
tool_list.description: Get detailed information about a specific pool. Requires network ID from getNetworks and a pool address.

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio

tool_list.name: getTokenDetails

tool_list.name: getTokenPools
tool_list.description: Get liquidity pools containing a specific token on a network. Great for finding where a token is traded.

reorder.description: If true, reorders the pool so that the specified token becomes the primary token for all metrics

address.description: Filter pools that contain this additional token address

tool_list.name: getPoolOHLCV
tool_list.description: Get historical price data (OHLCV) for a pool - essential for price analysis, backtesting, and visualization. Requires network and pool address.

start.description: Start time for historical data (Unix timestamp, RFC3339 timestamp, or yyyy-mm-dd format)

end.description: End time for historical data (max 1 year from start)

limit.description: Number of data points to retrieve (max 366) - adjust for different analysis needs

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio for alternative pair perspective (e.g., ETH/USDC vs USDC/ETH)

tool_list.name: getPoolTransactions
tool_list.description: Get recent transactions for a specific pool. Shows swaps, adds, removes. Requires network and pool address.

page.description: Page number for pagination (up to 100 pages)

cursor.description: Transaction ID used for cursor-based pagination

tool_list.name: search

query.description: Search term (e.g., "uniswap", "bitcoin", or a token address)

tool_list.name: getNetworks
tool_list.description: REQUIRED FIRST STEP: Get all supported blockchain networks. Always call this first to see available networks before using any network-specific functions. Returns network IDs like "ethereum", "solana", etc.

tool_list.name: getNetworkDexes
tool_list.description: Get available DEXes on a specific network. First call getNetworks to see valid network IDs.

tool_list.name: getNetworkPools
tool_list.description: PRIMARY POOL FUNCTION: Get top liquidity pools on a specific network. This is the MAIN way to get pool data - there is NO global pools function. Use this instead of any "getTopPools" or "getAllPools" concepts.

tool_list.name: getDexPools
tool_list.description: Get pools from a specific DEX on a network. First use getNetworks, then getNetworkDexes to find valid DEX IDs.

tool_list.name: getPoolDetails
tool_list.description: Get detailed information about a specific pool. Requires network ID from getNetworks and a pool address.

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio

tool_list.name: getTokenDetails
tool_list.description: Get detailed information about a specific token on a network. First use getNetworks to get valid network IDs.

tool_list.name: getTokenPools
tool_list.description: Get liquidity pools containing a specific token on a network. Great for finding where a token is traded.

reorder.description: If true, reorders the pool so that the specified token becomes the primary token for all metrics

address.description: Filter pools that contain this additional token address

tool_list.name: getPoolOHLCV
tool_list.description: Get historical price data (OHLCV) for a pool - essential for price analysis, backtesting, and visualization. Requires network and pool address.

start.description: Start time for historical data (Unix timestamp, RFC3339 timestamp, or yyyy-mm-dd format)

end.description: End time for historical data (max 1 year from start)

limit.description: Number of data points to retrieve (max 366) - adjust for different analysis needs

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio for alternative pair perspective (e.g., ETH/USDC vs USDC/ETH)

tool_list.name: getPoolTransactions
tool_list.description: Get recent transactions for a specific pool. Shows swaps, adds, removes. Requires network and pool address.

page.description: Page number for pagination (up to 100 pages)

cursor.description: Transaction ID used for cursor-based pagination

tool_list.name: search
tool_list.description: Search across ALL networks for tokens, pools, and DEXes by name, symbol, or address. Good starting point when you don't know the specific network.

query.description: Search term (e.g., "uniswap", "bitcoin", or a token address)

end.description: End time for historical data (max 1 year from start)

limit.description: Number of data points to retrieve (max 366) - adjust for different analysis needs

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio for alternative pair perspective (e.g., ETH/USDC vs USDC/ETH)
